summary: Trace paths to collect items. An educational calm logic game for ages 3-5
description:
A FUN PUZZLE GAME THAT BUILDS LOGIC FROM AGE 4
Help Pango draw a path without ever crossing the same road twice.

70 evolving challenges that boost your child’s logic, observation skills, and patience…
A calm, pressure-free game designed to support reflection, independence, and self-confidence - at their own pace.

15 YEARS OF EXPERTISE SERVING YOUNG CHILDREN
Our Pango collection includes over 20 apps known for their educational value, accessibility, and child-friendly design.
With more than 15 million children around the world already playing, Pango One Road continues our commitment to creating smart, simple, and kind games that make learning fun.

A GAME FOR THINKING AT YOUR OWN PACE
•  Designed for children ages 4 and up
•  Evolving levels with no stress or scores
•  Builds logic, observation, and planning skills
•  Encourages independence and confidence
•  A colorful, intuitive world with no ads
Each level is a small logic challenge that nurtures focus and the joy of success - without pressure.

A SMOOTH EXPERIENCE ON SMARTPHONES AND TABLETS
• Instantly accessible, designed for small hands
• Clean design, simple and fluid gestures
• Perfect for short sessions, travel, or quiet time

A SIMPLE AND TRANSPARENT SUBSCRIPTION
Pango One Road uses a monthly or yearly subscription.
You get full access to the game, with no hidden purchases.

• Auto-renewal (can be turned off anytime in your account settings)
• No cancellation fees
• Your previous purchases remain available

A 100% SAFE GAME
• No ads
• No external links
• A protected Parents section
• Complies with child privacy regulations

A TEAM THAT CARES AND LISTENS
For 15 years, we’ve been creating games at a child’s level.
Games that respect their pace, spark curiosity, and grow their logic - without stress, pressure, or ads. Because a great game is one that helps children grow!
Need help? Contact us at pango@studio-pango.com or visit our FAQ. More info: www.studio-pango.com

DOWNLOAD PANGO ONE ROAD and start your child on 70 fun and brain-boosting challenges!
